summary: Petrobras filed a Form 6-K announcing a shareholder remuneration of R$9.03 billion, or R$0.70097272 per share, as an anticipation of 2026 fiscal-year distribution, approved by the Board of Directors. The amount equals 45% of free cash flow under the company's policy. Payment will be in two installments of interest on equity in August and September 2026, with record dates on June 1 (B3) and June 3 (NYSE). ADR holders will receive payments later. This is a routine capital return, not a special situation.
